decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks fit the firm's core thermoforming consumables range, have their own web page, and cost little to carry, so with no shortfall against aspiration there is no trigger for search.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a staple material for dental laboratories, sits squarely within the established business, and has visible market presence, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website and its results are uncertain, but it is a cheap complementary consumable that the slack of a large firm can easily carry.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's strategic move into digital scanning workflows, which justifies tolerating early uncertainty using organisational slack.
Custom earmolds belong to the firm's skilled custom-device manufacturing base for hearing-care retailers, so there is little reason to drop them only one year after launch.
Custom hearing protection uses the same earmold production capabilities and serves a growing market, so the firm keeps it while results remain near aspiration.
